HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada? (1 mark)
   A. Use Kalpasutra and Dhammapada to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Kalpasutra and Dhammapada has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kalpasutra and Dhammapada.
   D. Apply the teaching of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

4. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   D. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

6. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Specific morning? (1 mark)
   A. Use Specific morning to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Specific morning has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Specific morning with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Specific morning.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Qualities of? (1 mark)
   A. Say Qualities of has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities of.
   C. Use Qualities of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Qualities of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Religious has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.
   D. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.
   B. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Myself has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
